meta.name: async-python-patterns
meta.description: Master Python asyncio, concurrent programming, and async/await patterns for high-performance applications. Use when building async APIs, concurrent systems, or I/O-bound applications requiring non-blocking operations.

copy.tagline: 写出高性能异步并发代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在 Python 里做高并发 I/O 开发
copy.tagline_en: Build fast non-blocking concurrent apps with Python asyncio
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle many simultaneous requests in Python

howto.what: 该技能指导 Claude 编写 Python 异步代码:提供 asyncio、async/await 和并发模式的具体示例与讲解,涵盖事件循环、任务、超时、队列、信号量等,并给出同步/异步选型建议。
howto.when: 当用户编写异步 API、并发请求或 I/O 密集任务,或要求使用 asyncio、async/await 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 asyncio.gather 并行抓取三个网址,每个加 5 秒超时。
say.note: 会生成带 wait_for 超时的并发抓取代码。

say.text: 写一个生产者-消费者异步队列,2 个生产者 3 个消费者。
say.note: 会给出基于 asyncio.Queue 的完整示例。

say.text: 这个 CPU 密集函数怎么和 async 代码配合?
say.note: 会建议用 asyncio.to_thread 卸载到线程池。

howto.what_en: Guides Claude to write Python async code with concrete asyncio/async-await examples, covering event loops, tasks, timeouts, queues, semaphores, plus sync-vs-async recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user writes async APIs, concurrent requests, or I/O-bound tasks, or asks to use asyncio or async/await.

say_en.text: Use asyncio.gather to fetch three URLs concurrently, each with a 5-second timeout.
say_en.note: Generates concurrent fetch code with wait_for timeout.

say_en.text: Write a producer-consumer async queue with 2 producers and 3 consumers.
say_en.note: Provides a full example based on asyncio.Queue.

say_en.text: How can this CPU-bound function work with async code?
say_en.note: Suggests offloading it to a thread pool with asyncio.to_thread.
